evidence.detail: The controlled harness selected .NET SDK 9.0.313 and the pinned project, then the actual build exited 1 with CS4036 at MainWindow.xaml.cs awaiting ContentDialog.ShowAsync(), followed by cascading XAML compiler MSB3073.

build.reason: The frozen generated implementation did not compile and was preserved without repair.
